visualReview.notes: Actually inspected90 final images:13 portable,13 shared-material,29 medium-fi lighting/LOD and35 normal-placement terrain views. This round inspected seven actual museum photographs: Castle Square facade, Great Courtyard with Wladyslaw tower/Gothic wall, river facade, oblique river facade and three aerial river/campus views. The aerials do not show an exact courtyard plan. Red city facade/central clock/two corner crowns, irregular roofless court, courtyard tower and pale three-pavilion river facade remain legible. Independent derivative follows reconciled fresh corners. Clock Gate and newly authored Grodzka Gate are true open barrel passages, not dark discs; normal placement shows both through to the court. Gothic pointed blind-bay rhythm is an opaque reconstruction over the brick wall. River ground-floor arches are opaque reserves; they do not claim open interiors. Copper profiles, clocks, roof dormers/chimneys and abstracted crests survive near tiers. Attached low library and bounded buried masonry foundation meet retained diagnostic terrain. Flat shared placement exposes the foundation; contact approval comes from the separate normal-placement fixture.
